AccountChoice.description: One account a step, an agent or a chat may name for an app's calls, with what tells it apart.
AccountChoice.title: AccountChoice

AccountIn.title: AccountIn

AccountOwner.description:
Whose sign-in a row is: the team's (`name` the team), an account each person signs in to (`each`, `name` the
caller), or one person's own sign-in on a team account (`person`, `name` that person).
AccountOwner.title: AccountOwner

AccountTest.description: An account's last test: it runs right after a sign-in, and a failure warns without disconnecting it.
AccountTest.title: AccountTest

AnotherOwnIn.description:
A person's second account of their own on an app: its name, which steps and chats pick it by and which no other
account of the app in the team holds, and where it signs in (the app's per-account settings, such as a company
server's address), kept as given rather than copied from the account it starts from.
AnotherOwnIn.title: AnotherOwnIn

AppAccount.description:
One row of the app's Accounts list: one of the team's accounts (the default is the one live calls use unless
they name another, and a sandbox one is what test runs use), or one person's own sign-in on it (`kind` person).
AppAccount.title: AppAccount

AppCredential.description:
One OAuth client the team's apps sign in with: one of the team's own (app_credentials, made under Credentials)
or Ops AI's app for an app whose accounts use it. Never its secret.
AppCredential.title: AppCredential

AppCredentialIn.description: The team's own OAuth app for one of its apps (the New app credential window); no account needed.
AppCredentialIn.title: AppCredentialIn

AppCredentialPatchIn.description:
An edit of the team's own app credential: any of its name, client id, permissions and settings. Its secret is
replaced on its own route.
AppCredentialPatchIn.title: AppCredentialPatchIn

AppMe.description: The caller's own sign-in on the app's account: Connect my account, or Connected as.
AppMe.title: AppMe

AppPage.description:
One app's page, joined here: its card, its default account, the caller's own sign-in, how many people
signed in, its auth configs with their accounts, its tools, the plugin's skills and the latest runs
of its tools.
AppPage.title: AppPage

AppUsers.description: Who uses an app's tools in the team, read before turning it off.
AppUsers.title: AppUsers

AuthConfig.description:
How the app's accounts sign in: Ops AI's own OAuth app, one the team made (an app credential), or, for a kind
with no OAuth client, each account's own key; with the accounts signing in through it. Only the team's own is
edited or deleted.
AuthConfig.title: AuthConfig

CallRunAs.description: Whom a call ran as: a person (by the email their acting-for token named) or the team account.
CallRunAs.title: CallRunAs

CodeLimitsIn.description: What a run may use; runner-service holds each to the deployment's cap whatever is asked.
CodeLimitsIn.title: CodeLimitsIn

CodeSettings.description: A code operation's function: what runs, the tools it may call and the secrets it may hand them.
CodeSettings.title: CodeSettings

ConfigField.description:
One sign-in value an auth config holds (a plugin's `asked: config` setting, such as Salesforce's sign-in
address), as its row and details show it.
ConfigField.title: ConfigField

ConnectLinkIn.description: A connect link a call that needed someone's own sign-in handed back; only that person opens it.
ConnectLinkIn.title: ConnectLinkIn

Connection.description: How to sign in to one mailbox; the password goes by its secret's name only.
Connection.title: Connection

ConnectionHealth.description: The last Test connection: a read of the system's test address, signed in with `account`'s sign-in.
ConnectionHealth.title: ConnectionHealth

CredentialAccount.description: An account signing in with an app credential, as its page lists it.
CredentialAccount.title: CredentialAccount

CredentialField.description:
A setting an auth config holds, as its New and Edit windows draw and check it: a plugin's setting `asked:
config` (or one of its credential_settings), or a custom app's client field. The console builds its form schema
from these, and the API checks a saved value against the same.
CredentialField.title: CredentialField

GrantableOperation.description: A tool an agent may be granted: a published operation, with what a model needs to choose and call it.
GrantableOperation.title: GrantableOperation

HostList.description: GET /v1/egress/hosts: one page of the listed hosts.
HostList.title: HostList

IdentityEntry.description:
One thing that tells an account apart from the app's others (an org's address, a server, who signed in), as
plugins.host.account_identity builds it.
IdentityEntry.title: IdentityEntry

ModuleSourceIn.description: `{kind: 'mcp', url}` or `{kind: 'openapi', specUrl | fileName | fileId}`, each with an optional connection.
ModuleSourceIn.title: ModuleSourceIn

MyAccount.description: One of the caller's own sign-ins, as Your connections lists it.
MyAccount.title: MyAccount

MyConnector.description: One app that acts as the caller, as Connectors (Mine) lists it.
MyConnector.title: MyConnector

NewAppIn.description:
A custom app a builder adds, as its first account: by name with a sign-in kind, or an MCP server by its address,
whose sign-in is found from the server.
NewAppIn.title: NewAppIn

OperationPatchIn.description:
A field left out is unchanged; `binding: null` removes the binding. The call shape (method, path, headers,
body, transform, timeout) applies to http operations only; `responseTransform: null` or `timeoutMs: null` clears
it, back to no transform and the module timeout.
OperationPatchIn.title: OperationPatchIn

PackageCheck.description: One package app's check on an account: the objects it requires that the account's system does not have.
PackageCheck.title: PackageCheck

Permission.description:
One permission an app asks for: its id, as the system names it and a credential holds it, and what it lets Ops AI
do, in plain words. A required one is always asked for.
Permission.title: Permission

PersonCredentialsIn.description:
A person's own key, password or token on an account each person signs in to: the kind's person
fields, each a value of at most 2,000 characters.
PersonCredentialsIn.title: PersonCredentialsIn

PersonSignedIn.description: One person's own sign-in on an account: admins see everyone's, a person their own.
PersonSignedIn.title: PersonSignedIn

PluginUpdateView.description: What taking the installed version would change for the team: empty `tools` when it runs it already.
PluginUpdateView.title: PluginUpdateView

ReviewDecisionIn.description: A decision made in Reviews, sent by agents-service.
ReviewDecisionIn.title: ReviewDecisionIn

RunContext.description: Where the call comes from. Who calls is not here: it is the verified service token's subject (I13).
RunContext.title: RunContext

SecretList.description: GET /v1/secrets?page=: one page of the secrets' metadata.
SecretList.title: SecretList

SecretNeed.description: A `{{NAME}}` an operation's headers or path read, and whether the tenant has set it.
SecretNeed.title: SecretNeed

SettingChoice.description: One value the setting takes, in the system's words; `test_account` starts the Test account switch on.
SettingChoice.title: SettingChoice

SettingOther.description:
A host typed in place of a choice: the value is `value` with `{host}` replaced, and the host must end in one of
`hosts`; a host ending in one of `test_account_hosts` starts the Test account switch on.
SettingOther.title: SettingOther

SignInCompleteIn.description:
What the sign-in page was handed back: the `code` of a sign-in the system allowed, or the `error` and
`errorDescription` of one it refused, with the `state` either way.
SignInCompleteIn.title: SignInCompleteIn

SignInFinished.description:
A finished sign-in, as the return page tells the window that started it: the account and its app, and either
the account signed in or, for Test with my account (`check`), the check's outcome.
SignInFinished.title: SignInFinished

SignInValue.description:
Where an account signs in and what its sign-in found, in the plugin's words: its sign-in address (`place`) and
each value filled at sign-in (`found`), such as Salesforce's org address.
SignInValue.title: SignInValue

TestDraftIn.description:
The workbench's unsaved transform and mock, tried by one test without staging them. A key left out
uses the operation's own; `responseTransform: null` runs with no transform.
TestDraftIn.title: TestDraftIn

ToolCallRow.description: One gateway call as the console's ToolCallRow, with the identity fields the executions log fills.
ToolCallRow.title: ToolCallRow

ToolChange.description: One tool an update adds, changes or removes, by its operation name.
ToolChange.title: ToolChange

ToolGrant.description: A workflow's access to one module, as the Access tab lists it across modules.
ToolGrant.title: ToolGrant

ToolGrantList.description:
GET /v1/tool-modules/grants: one page, with `facets.view` counting active, expiring, requested, expired, ended
and all.
ToolGrantList.title: ToolGrantList

ToolRunIn.description:
One run of one tool from its page: Mock answers from its mock and reaches nothing, Real is the gateway
call, with every check, in the environment picked.
ToolRunIn.title: ToolRunIn
